hook: Every word in a sentence quietly looks at every other word. How does an AI decide which ones matter?
definition: Attention lets a model weigh how relevant each token is to every other token, so each word's vector is updated with context from the words that matter most.
analogy: A group chat where each word decides whose messages to read closely.
